description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractLeaveEmailProcessor' which serves as a base for handling email processing related to leave requests within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving subscribers, recipients based on roles, supervisors, leave details, and comments, utilizing various services and traits. The file is part of the leave email processing subsystem in the OrangeHRM leave plugin.

classes.name: AbstractLeaveEmailProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class providing common email processing functionalities for leave-related notifications, including fetching recipients, subscribers, leave details, comments, and handling role-based and event-based email subscribers.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestCommentService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of LeaveRequestCommentService.

methods.name: getSubscribersForEvent
methods.description: Retrieves email subscribers for a specific notification event ID.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Fetches employees with a specified role, given an employee context.

methods.name: getSelf
methods.description: Returns the recipient information for the employee itself.

methods.name: getSubscribers
methods.description: Gets a list of recipients subscribed to specific leave-related email notifications based on email name.

methods.name: getSupervisors
methods.description: Retrieves the supervisor(s) of a given employee.

methods.name: getLeaveDetailsByDetailedLeaves
methods.description: Formats detailed leave entries into a summary list with date, time, and duration.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestComments
methods.description: Fetches comments related to a specific leave request.
